note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user account controls (Donate, Create account, Log in)
Page title bar -- renders: 'Search' heading and 'Help' link
Appearance settings panel -- renders: 'Appearance' label, 'Unpin' button, font size options (Small, Standard, Large), width options (Standard, Full), theme options (OS, Day, Night)
Search input controls -- renders: search field, 'Search' button, and result count summary
Advanced search options toggle -- renders: 'Search options' button and preview of selected filters
Namespace filter toggle -- renders: 'Namespaces' button and preview of selected namespaces (e.g., 'Main')
Create article prompt -- renders: fixed text 'Create the page' and links to 'Create page' and 'Help'
Results per page selector -- renders: dropdown with options '10', '20', '50', '100', '200'

Site footer -- renders: 'Privacy policy', 'About Wikipedia', 'Disclaimers', 'Contact Wikipedia', 'Legal & safety contacts', 'Code of Conduct', 'Developers', 'Statistics', 'Cookie statement', 'Mobile view', Wikimedia Foundation and MediaWiki logos
